arguments.code: const p=await browser.page(18);const state=await p.evaluate(()=>{const v=document.querySelector('video');v?.pause();return {href:location.href,paused:v?.paused,captionLabel:document.querySelector('.ytp-subtitles-button')?.getAttribute('aria-label'),captionPressed:document.querySelector('.ytp-subtitles-button')?.getAttribute('aria-pressed'),player:!!document.querySelector('#movie_player')}});const s=await p.snapshot({mode:'interactive',depth:8});return {state,buttons:s.refs.filter(x=>x.role==='button').map(x=>({ref:x.ref,name:x.name}))};
